title: Gate reproduced from a separate worktree; two clean-checkout defects found and fixed (F11)
experiment_condition: development (agent-authored and agent-evaluated; NOT independently evaluated)
why_this_run_exists: Every earlier run used the original working directory, which carried a populated build/ tree. The closure task requires the candidate commands to work from a clean checkout, so the gate was executed in a separate Git worktree containing only tracked files. That failed, which is the result that matters: two stages had been passing only because of untracked build output.

tested_revisions.final: eff293d (worktree at eff293d, tracked files only, git status empty)

new_finding.summary: Two supported commands depended on build directories that existed only in the original checkout.
new_finding.failure_1: scripts/fw/as.js wrote build/fw/boot.hex without creating build/fw -> ENOENT; the boot regression reported IMAGE-FAIL and the suite 26/27.
new_finding.failure_2: asic/synthesis/memory_audit.ys writes into build/asic_evidence/memory_audit/ and this Yosys build has no `file mkdir` -> "ERROR: Can't create file"; the memory self-test then reported BLOCKED and the design stage exited 1 without a verdict.
new_finding.fix: producers create their own output directories; audit_memory.js gains --elaborate (mkdir + yosys + check) as the documented entry point and elaborates the self-test baseline on demand.

preservation_note: The raw logs of the first failing worktree were destroyed when that worktree was removed, before they had been archived. The defects were therefore reproduced deterministically at d09d59e in a second worktree and logged (logs/defects_at_d09d59e.log); this is a reproduction of the failure, not the original capture, and it is labelled that way.
classification: BLOCKED (ASIC readiness) — no FAIL at the final revision; every executed check passed
